additional_info.subject: ID0382689-DC/Si-D/FI-[Y2 / R4 313038785006] Display touchscreen doesnt work CRM:00642001588
additional_info.body:
Hello Markus,
Hope you are doing well.
Based on the issue and the video, the touch functionality isn’t working. Please follow the troubleshooting steps listed below.
Please verify the most recent firmware for the D-logic controller. Ascertain whether FC-12 in the automation area has tripped. Examine all wiring associated with the HMI and D-logic controller.
Make sure the PCB is firmly connected during update and handle it with extra care as they are prone to damage with any push and pull force to the flat ribbon cable.
Refer :
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Screen Upside Down_HMI Touch Repsonse - Dynamics 365
